verdict.rationale: mParticle is a customer data platform with AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents a policy or control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The GDPR/CCPA consent filters and data-sale opt-out forwarding rules are adjacent privacy controls for downstream forwarding, not an AI-training exclusion, so they earn no credit here.
